ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AAA Technologies Limited has submitted its routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming efficient share registry operations. The certificate, issued by MUFG Intime India Private Limited, verifies that physical share certificates received for dematerialization were properly cancelled and shareholder records updated within the prescribed timelines, indicating strong regulatory adherence and no material red flags or adverse impacts.
